description: Render parsed Markdown as CommonMark XML, optionally including source position attributes for document and child nodes.

cases.expected_output:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE document SYSTEM "CommonMark.dtd">
<document xmlns="http://commonmark.org/xml/1.0">
  <paragraph>
    <text xml:space="preserve">foo </text>
    <emph>
      <text xml:space="preserve">bar</text>
    </emph>
  </paragraph>
  <paragraph>
    <text xml:space="preserve">paragraph 2</text>
  </paragraph>
  <code_block xml:space="preserve">code
</code_block>
</document>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE document SYSTEM "CommonMark.dtd">
<document sourcepos="1:1-7:3" xmlns="http://commonmark.org/xml/1.0">
  <paragraph sourcepos="1:1-1:9">
    <text sourcepos="1:1-1:4" xml:space="preserve">foo </text>
    <emph sourcepos="1:5-1:9">
      <text sourcepos="1:6-1:8" xml:space="preserve">bar</text>
    </emph>
  </paragraph>
  <paragraph sourcepos="3:1-3:11">
    <text sourcepos="3:1-3:11" xml:space="preserve">paragraph 2</text>
  </paragraph>
  <code_block sourcepos="5:1-7:3" xml:space="preserve">code
</code_block>
</document>
